title: fix(app-shell): a draft-only object's new or first-edited list view starts from its first five fields
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXNFpXQRAPXfpTaqkV

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuT5kyf3nN85tsw9JVYCnhMd)_

Fixes #30317

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 界面里，一个还只是草稿的对象，第一次编辑它的默认列表视图、或用「新建视图」不选列时，视图现在从对象的前五个字段起步，和已发布对象一样；之前起步是零列。
- 为什么改：面板只从外壳的合并元数据里找对象定义来生成默认列，草稿对象不在其中，于是默认列为空：第一次编辑只写进作者刚加的那一列，新建视图一列都没有。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `useObjectListViewDraft` 的默认列这一段。合并元数据里找不到对象时，多读一次本包的草稿对象定义（`GET /meta/object/:name?preview=draft&package=`，字段选择器已在读同一个地址）；已发布对象不多发请求；读失败或读不到时仍是空，和以前一样。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` 里 `seedColumns` 上方新增的 `draftedDef` 一段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.draftObjectSeed-30317.test.tsx`，预期 4 个用例全绿；在 main 上同一文件 3 个失败。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

In Studio › Interfaces, `useObjectListViewDraft` seeds the columns of a list view created in the panel (the first edit of a view that does not exist yet, and New view with no columns picked) with `defaultListColumnsFromObject(objectDef, 5)`. `objectDef` came only from the shell's merged `metadata.objects`, which holds published objects, so on a draft-only object the seed was `[]`.

- When the merged definition is missing, the hook now reads the object's drafted definition from this package through the same client with the drafts overlaid (`client.withPreviewDrafts(true).get('object', name, { packageId })`, the read `useObjectFields` already makes for the panel's field picker) and seeds from it. The answer is keyed on `[packageId, objectName]` and re-read after a publish.
- A published object reads nothing new: the effect does not run while the merged definition is present.
- A failed read, or a 404 (neither drafted nor published), seeds nothing, as before, and is never the panel's failure.
- Nothing else in the hook changes: target resolution, the buffer load, the save and the view switcher are untouched, so the hunks stay away from PR #30401 and PR #30339, which edit other parts of this file.

Changeset: `.changeset/30317-draft-only-object-view-seed.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-9n7hb1`, not `claude/issue-30317-*`; the card is #30317.

## Tests

New file `ObjectListViewInspector.draftObjectSeed-30317.test.tsx`: the real hook over a real `MetadataClient`, whose transport is an in-memory server that serves `GET /meta/object/:name?preview=draft` in its envelope and 404 otherwise, and records the PUTs.

- draft-only `acmetrial_deal` (absent from the merged metadata, a hidden field first): `seedColumns` is its first five visible fields, the canvas shows them, and the first edit (made as the panel makes it, adding `notes`) PUTs `view/acmetrial_deal.default` with those five plus `notes`;
- New view (`createView` with a grid payload and no columns) PUTs `view/acmetrial_deal.open_deals` with the same five;
- CONTROL: a published object seeds from the merged definition and no `GET /meta/object/...` is sent for it;
- CONTROL: an object neither drafted nor published: one 404 read, seed `[]`, no failure, the buffer still loads.

On `origin/main` (`989ae42d`) the file reads 3 failed, 1 passed (the seed is `[]`; the 404 control fails because no read is sent). With the fix, 4 passed. Since the pre-fix run is the same file over the unpatched hook, no separate ablation was run.

- At `0be094aa` (fix, before merging `main`): every app-shell test file importing `ObjectListViewInspector` or `StudioDesignSurface`, 241 files, `--maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 241 passed (241)`, `Tests 1751 passed (1751)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. eslint on the two touched files: 0 errors (22 warnings, all on lines this PR does not touch).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `0be094aa` (3 paths): 35 commands, run serially, every one exit 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (`Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 4985 passed | 2 skipped`). `--ran` with the recorded exit codes: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero). Also run: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`, `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`, each exit 0.
- At `af914a2d` (after merging `main` `a1d0b1ee`, which carries PR #30339's edit of this file; no conflict; app-shell closure rebuilt): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`, every test file under `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` (`Test Files 330 passed (330)`, `Tests 2473 passed (2473)`) and `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`, one chained run, VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

Not run locally: the full ui suite (CI's Test UI shards run it).

## Verification

Dev boot of `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) after the `@object-ui/app-shell` and showcase build closure, console Vite pointed at it, Playwright Chromium at 1440×900, signed in as the dev admin. Seeded over REST: writable package `com.example.acme-trial` (`POST /api/v1/packages`), then with `?mode=draft` the object `acmetrial_deal` (fields name, amount, stage, close_date, probability, notes) and the app `acmetrial_app`, whose one nav entry is the object. Opened the entry in Studio › Interfaces. Before = `origin/main`'s hook; after = this branch's, served by Vite HMR; the view drafts were discarded (`DELETE …?state=draft`) between the two.

| | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Panel on opening the entry | "Columns 0 · No columns yet" | Columns 5: Deal name, Amount, Stage, Close date, Probability |
| First edit (Add field → Notes) PUTs `view/acmetrial_deal.default` with columns | `[{ field: notes }]` | `[name, amount, stage, close_date, probability, notes]` |
| New view (Grid, "Open deals", no columns picked) PUTs `view/acmetrial_deal.open_deals` with columns | `[]` | `[name, amount, stage, close_date, probability]` |

Shots (1440 wide) and the recorded PUT bodies are in the project's `issue-30317/` folder (`before-1-opened-1440.png`, `before-2-first-edit-1440.png`, `before-3-new-view-1440.png`, the three `after-*` shots, `puts.json`); this repository has no place to commit them, per `ui/AGENTS.md` Housekeeping.

## Acceptance notes

- The drafted read is asynchronous and is sent when the leaf opens, beside the view-drafts read that already gates a default entry. An edit made before it answers would still start from no columns; on the dev boot it answered before the panel finished loading.
- The before leg's first edit wrote the column as `{ field, label }` and the after leg's as a bare name: the column editor keeps the shape of the list it is handed, and the seed is bare names, as it is for a published object today. Not changed here.
